day1_meet_police.text: Afternoon. I just saw that kid hanging around and I have to say...

choices.text: Ask if the police can help

police_offer_help.text: Alright... Just remember to be careful

police_explain.text: We can patrol the area more, but we can’t protect your shop 24/7.

day2_gang_intro.text: You reckon you could sell some of these hoons? Boss is tryna find suppliers

who_is_boss.text: Don’t worry ‘bout names… we’re part of the Gumboot Gang.

gang_leave.text: Fair enough. Offers still on the table. I’ll swing by tomorrow and see what you decide.

sell_hoons.text: I see you’ve got Hoons now?

after_sell_hoons.text: I got to get into the club tomorrow but I’m underage. You reckon you could start selling Fake IDs?

refuse_sell.text: Boss ain’t gonna like this… You’re all good man, stay safe

agree_fake_ids.text: Sweettt, thanks m’bro, I appreciate it.

ending_ram_raid.text: The shop was ram raided. Neutral Ending.
